syncNow.pullFailed: Could not reach the sync server. Try again.
syncNow.accountMismatch: This device still holds another account's data. Open the extension to switch accounts.
syncNow.identityChanged: The extension was signed out during the sync. Sign in and try again.
syncNow.keyCheckFailed: Could not check the encryption status. Try again.
syncNow.setupUnfinished: Open the extension to finish encryption setup.
syncNow.locked: Open the extension and unlock encryption to sync.
